name: Panel-joke
summary: A panel-based semi-automated trading EA that compares the current bar's Open, High, Low, and Close prices against the previous bar to generate a buy/sell momentum signal (0-7 score). It features a GUI panel with manual Buy/Sell/Close buttons and an autopilot mode that automatically opens or reverses positions based on the signal strength.
summary_zh: 一个基于面板的半自动交易EA，通过比较当前K线与前一根K线的开盘价、最高价、最低价和收盘价来生成买卖动量信号（0-7分）。具有GUI面板，支持手动买卖平仓按钮，以及根据信号强度自动开仓或反转仓位的自动驾驶模式。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于简单的价格动量比较：将当前K线的开盘价、最高价、最低价、收盘价分别与前一根K线对比，以及计算(H+L)/2、(H+L+C)/3、(H+L+C+C)/4的复合均值进行对比，共7项指标投票决定多空方向。入场条件为：手动模式下点击Buy/Sell按钮开仓，或自动驾驶模式下当买入信号数大于卖出信号数时做多，反之做空。出场条件仅有手动平仓按钮和自动驾驶模式下的仓位反转（先平后开反向仓），没有任何止损或止盈设置。仓位管理采用固定0.01手数，不根据账户余额或风险动态调整。资金管理完全缺失，无止损止盈、无最大持仓限制、无回撤控制，风险暴露极高。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on simple bar-to-bar price momentum comparison: it compares the current bar's Open, High, Low, and Close against the previous bar, plus three composite averages ((H+L)/2, (H+L+C)/3, (H+L+C+C)/4), for a total of 7 directional votes. Entry conditions are: manual Buy/Sell button clicks on the GUI panel, or in autopilot mode, a BUY when buy votes exceed sell votes and a SELL when sell votes exceed buy votes. Exit conditions are limited to a manual Close button and autopilot position reversals (close then open opposite direction), with absolutely no stop-loss or take-profit levels. Position sizing is fixed at 0.01 lots regardless of account balance, equity, or risk parameters. Money management is entirely absent — there are no stop-losses, take-profits, maximum position limits, or drawdown controls, creating extremely high risk exposure.
pros: 界面直观，提供可视化面板显示买卖信号百分比和进度条
支持手动和自动两种交易模式，灵活性较好
信号计算逻辑简单透明，易于理解和验证
提供一键平仓功能，方便快速退出市场
pros_en: Intuitive GUI panel displaying buy/sell signal percentages and progress bars visually
Supports both manual and automated trading modes for flexibility
Signal calculation logic is simple and transparent, easy to understand and verify
Provides one-click close position button for quick market exit
cons: 完全没有止损和止盈设置，亏损可能无限扩大
固定手数0.01不做任何资金管理调整，不考虑账户风险承受能力
信号逻辑过于简单，仅比较相邻两根K线的价格大小，缺乏统计学支撑
自动驾驶模式下只做反转不设止损，频繁开平仓会导致大量点差成本
没有新K线检查机制，每个tick都会执行交易逻辑可能造成重复交易
cons_en: No stop-loss or take-profit at all — losses can grow indefinitely
Fixed 0.01 lot size with no money management adjustment, ignoring account risk capacity
Signal logic is overly simplistic, only comparing adjacent bar prices without statistical support
Autopilot mode only reverses positions without stops, frequent open/close leads to high spread costs
No new bar check mechanism, trading logic executes every tick which may cause duplicate trades
improvements: 添加止损和止盈参数，至少设置默认止损以控制最大亏损
增加新K线检查机制，确保每根K线只交易一次，避免tick级别重复开仓
优化信号逻辑，引入技术指标（如移动平均线、RSI）作为辅助确认，提高信号可靠性
improvements_en: Add stop-loss and take-profit parameters with at least a default stop-loss to control maximum loss
Implement a new bar check to ensure only one trade per bar, avoiding tick-level duplicate entries
Enhance signal logic by introducing technical indicators (e.g., moving averages, RSI) as confirmation to improve reliability

risk_points: 无止损止盈，单笔亏损无上限
无新K线检查，每个tick可能触发交易导致频繁开仓
自动驾驶模式下的反转交易不设止损，连续错误信号会造成连环亏损
无仓位检查保护（如最大持仓数限制），极端行情下可能过度交易
risk_points_en: No stop-loss or take-profit, single trade loss has no ceiling
No new bar check, every tick can trigger a trade causing frequent position opening
Autopilot reversal trades lack stops, consecutive wrong signals cause cascading losses
No position protection (e.g., max position limit), may over-trade in extreme markets

It features a GUI panel with manual Buy/Sell/Close buttons and an autopilot mode that automatically opens or reverses positions based on the signal strength.
